description: Build a booking link from known trip details. Opening it shows the booking page with the trip already filled in and, when origin, destination, date and time are given, the closed fare of the Mercedes-Benz V300 Atelier ready to book and pay on the website. Returns a URL only: it does NOT submit a booking. The fare is closed and paid on the website; only the Standard class, parties of 7 or more and trips outside the covered area are confirmed by a person. The pickup must respect the minimum notice (Madrid time, longer at night, and it depends on the vehicle category; https://privyde.com/developers#lead-time), which the booking form checks.

area.description: Main area or destination of an at-disposal (hourly) service, e.g. "Madrid centro".

hours.description: Hours at disposal, for a chauffeur by the hour with no fixed destination.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".
